title: Syblings, Ayalas, Lisa Gokongwei invest in fintech firm NextPay
summary: Other local investors that participated in the round include Kickstart Ventures of the Ayala Group, angel investor Lisa Gokongwei, Foxmont Capital and First Asia Ventures Gokongwei also joined the fundraise.
